newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Grintek to make "significant" announcement.
newsitem.headline: Grintek to make "significant" announcement.

text.p: South African electronics company Grintek Ltd said it would give details later on Thursday about an important deal likely to affect it, Siltek Ltd and the entire information technology sector.
Details will be announced at a news conference scheduled for 5.00 p.m. (1500 GMT).

"Grintek Ltd has decided to hold a press conference and give details of a significant move which will affect Grintek and Siltek and impact on the South African information technology scene as a whole," it said.
Thursday's announcement follows a cautionary announcement on Monday in which Siltek said it was involved negotiations which could affect its share price.
"We are confident that the information given at this conference will be of great interest," the company said.
